name: Mistwalker's Instinct
text:
Activate Cast a Spell

---
Wisps of fog and mist waft from this smooth, polished amulet in the shape of a raindrop. When used as a catalyst to cast a Mist spell, you can sense the direction of each creature from you within the mist, though you can't instinctively discern allies from enemies based on direction alone. The DC of flat checks you attempt to target a creature within the mist is reduced from 5 to 3.
